releaseNotes.headline: Your usage is the ocean
releaseNotes.summary: Memory and Storage become interactive sailing oceans: colored usage layers form the water, with readable names and byte counts on the waves, resource-driven weather, and 59 detailed animated ships that stay centered.

highlights.title: The layers are the ocean
highlights.detail: Open Memory or Storage from the rail to enter its sailing ocean. Colored usage layers form the moving water, with category names and byte counts directly on the waves. Select a layer to inspect its processes, tools, cache, or worktrees.

highlights.title: A fleet of 59 animated ships
highlights.detail: Choose from 12 classic ships and 47 stylized One Piece miniatures, with refined sails, rigging, hulls, and deck details. Memory and Storage remember their own ship choices, also shown in the rail’s miniatures.

highlights.title: Weather follows the resource
highlights.detail: Automatic weather follows macOS memory pressure or observed disk headroom. Choose any of eight weather conditions manually. Clearing previews keep weather tied to actual disk usage, and unavailable readings are clearly identified.

highlights.title: Centered ships, continuous exploration
highlights.detail: Ships drift gently around the center, stay afloat, and remain fully in view as the water moves. Explore usage without switching sailing modes or losing branch-review state. Existing clear reviews and Undo remain available.
